title: PersonaCR ops measurements (memory, embedding batches, analyze time, Claude review cost)

setup.cluster: minikube v1.35.1, docker driver, node capped at 6 GiB (Docker Desktop on WSL2, Windows 11 laptop, 15.6 GB RAM)
setup.backend_limit: 3 GiB memory limit (k8s/backend.yaml); worker has the same 3 GiB limit
setup.runs: single run per configuration; not repeated, no variance estimate

provenance_levels.archived_log: raw sampler / curl / job JSON output was captured to a file during the run; values copied here verbatim
provenance_levels.offline_recount: re-derived offline from the repo + tokenizer, no embedding (reproducible)
provenance_levels.session_only: seen in kubectl output during the session; the raw output was not saved and pod logs were lost on restart

caveat_on_before_after: The 'before' and 'after' analyze runs differ in THREE changes, not one: (1) token-budget batching padding fix (eb63cb4), (2) MAX_EMBED_TOKENS 2048 -> 1024 (279eb11), (3) MiniLM no longer preloaded at startup (079c2de). The deltas below are their combined effect and must not be attributed to batching alone.
